logging_semantics: Disabled mode emits no exported frame but preserves semantic state, writer metadata, counters, keys, schedules and ledgers. Every logged/unlogged epoch must agree on the full state.
external_activity_policy: Validate full environment phases; activity credit uses only actual native state/topology changes. Environment supply/extraction/transport receives no native activity credit.
admission_policy: Close only the two P00f blockers on successful replay, raw-mode equivalence, external-only controls, maintenance controls, and unchanged prior suites. P01 execution readiness remains a separate gate.
